summary: Smoke tested Onam booking backend + frontend. Event info, admin login, admin bookings list, admin auth header enforcement, and landing/admin UI all work. Booking creation is BLOCKED by a broken email-validator==2.3.0 that rejects every valid email with 'must have an @-sign' — confirmed by isolated pydantic test locally. This cascades to block upload-screenshot, admin confirm/reject, screenshot fetch, and 409 over-quantity paths, plus the frontend BookingDialog submit.
passed: GET /api/admin/bookings without header -> 401; with X-Admin-Password header -> 200 with bookings[] and stats{confirmed_slots,held_slots,remaining_slots,total_slots,revenue}
Landing / renders: hero-book-btn, sticky-book-btn, slots-badge ('Early Bird — Only 45 of 45 slots left!'), BookingDialog opens with all inputs

/admin renders admin-password-input; wrong password -> 'Invalid password' error visible; stellar2026 -> dashboard with stats cards (Confirmed 0/45, Held 0, Remaining 45, Revenue) and bookings-table with 'No bookings yet'

failed.issue: email-validator==2.3.0 is broken and rejects every valid email (e.g., [email protected], [email protected]) with 'value is not a valid email address: An email address must have an @-sign.' Confirmed via direct pydantic EmailStr test inside /app/backend (pydantic 2.13.4 + email-validator 2.3.0). This blocks POST /api/bookings entirely -> HTTP 422.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/bookings {full_name,phone,email:'[email protected]',quantity:1} -> 422 with the above detail. Local: `from pydantic import EmailStr; M(e='[email protected]')` raises same error.

failed.issue: Frontend BookingDialog submit does not navigate to /booking/{id}; stays on / (backend 422 above). Also browser-level HTML5 validation tooltip 'Please include an @' appears — email input value on preview appears scrambled by Cloudflare email obfuscation ([email protected] shows as [email protected]).
failed.evidence: Playwright: filled [email protected], clicked booking-submit-btn, URL remained https://…/. Screenshot shows Cloudflare-style obfuscation of the email in the input.

failed.issue: Could not verify POST /api/bookings 409 over-quantity, upload-screenshot, GET /api/bookings/{id}, admin confirm/reject, admin screenshot data_url, and slot decrement after confirm — all depend on being able to create a booking.
failed.evidence: Every attempted booking returns 422 due to email-validator bug.

action_items: Pin email-validator to a working version (e.g., 2.2.0) in /app/backend/requirements.txt, reinstall, and restart backend via supervisor. Then re-run booking + confirm flow.
After the fix, verify full flow: create booking -> qr_data_url present -> upload screenshot -> admin confirms -> /api/event/info shows remaining=44.

Investigate Cloudflare Email Protection on preview URL possibly altering user-typed emails in inputs; if the issue is only in preview automation, real users are fine, but the underlying pydantic error still blocks all real bookings.
